column1: # BirdView per-region presence. Generated by cmd/birdview-regions.
# A species is listed in a region when it reaches 1 record per million
# of that region's bird records, in eBird or iNaturalist (imports.md, `gbif`).
# A county lists a species its state lists, at one per million of the county's records
# and at least 5 records (decisions.countyListingRule). From GBIF download 0025636-261023074918325,
# whose DOI is recorded in data/gbif-downloads.tsv (tech.gbifDownloadsRecorded).
# Counts are twelve, January first, separated by |. They sum to the
# year exactly: every record carries a month, and birdview-regions
# refuses to write unless the twelve reconstruct it (product.regionAndMonthFilter, decisions.monthPresence).

column3: every bird record there, by month

column1: # A cell may end in ! and twelve 0/1 flags: the months eBird withholds the
# species there under its Sensitive Species list, confirmed against the
# records. A withheld month is missing by policy, not absent (decisions.ebirdSilenceNotAbsence).
# A region id followed by ~ is one where the species has records but stays
